basic_info.description: Nestled half a block from the Palace of Fine Arts, this elegant top-floor condo offers 1545 sq. ft. +/- of refined living in a fully updated Spanish Mediterranean 2-unit residence. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, this full floor flat seamlessly blends classic charm w/ modern conveniences. A designer kitchen boasts Neolith countertops, a b'fast bar, subway tile backsplash, custom cabinetry, and high-end appliances, including a Bertazzoni 5-burner range. The spacious living room offers light-filled ambiance, highlighted by four south-facing bay windows, accent wallpaper, and a marble fireplace. The formal dining room showcases vintage moldings, hardwood floors, and a custom chandelier. Down the hall, a split 1 bathroom offers a updated powder room and a vintage bath w/ tiled stall shower, tub, and skylight. Both bedrooms overlook an expansive shared garden and include modern light fixtures and custom California closet systems w/ the primary offering white-oak built-ins. Additional highlights: custom paint, refinished hardwood floors, 3 skylights, recessed lighting, in-unit laundry closet w/ full-size stackable machines, deeded parking and storage. Unbeatable location - steps from Crissy Field, Marina Green, the Palace of Fine Arts, and Chestnut St. shops, restaurants & nightlife!
